description: The intensity is the restarts in the window per second of the window, here 1.5 s: with a threshold of 1.5 restarts per second the first batch (1/1.5) and the second (2/1.5) do not cross it and the third (3/1.5 = 2) does, so restart_storm is traced at the third batch; the fourth failure is refused under STOP.
